And she said,--"Oh, Cocky-locky, the sky is falling, and I am going to tell the king." And Cocky-locky said,--"I will go with you, Henny-penny." So Cocky-locky and Henny-penny, they gaed, and they gaed, and they gaed, till they met a Duck. So the Duck said,--"Where are you going to-day, Cocky-locky and Henny-penny?" And they said,--"Oh, Ducky-daddles, the sky is falling, and we are going to tell the king." And Ducky-daddles said,--"I will go with you, Cocky-locky and Henny-penny." So Ducky-daddles, and Cocky-locky, and Henny-penny, they gaed, and they gaed, and they gaed, till they met a Goose.
